description: x402 whats-new: catalog diff since a timestamp. Returns added_endpoints[] (first_seen >= since), removed_endpoints[] (is_active=false AND last_seen >= since), and counts. Default window: 24h. Price changes are not yet tracked — coming in /api/v1/price-history. Cheap ($0.001) so polling agents can run hourly without breaking the bank.
